QUOTE: "It does not repeat on failure, so it is not retry." and the table row "`LlamaCppTokenizer::tokenize` | empty `vector<int32_t>` | `llama_cpp_tokenizer.cpp:64-68`, after one `logger->error`"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the second call (line 61) is not retried on failure and that failure returns an empty vector after one error log. That is terminal-empty behaviour, though it never names the negative result of the second call explicitly.
